intro.text: VIDA Global Inc. (the “Company”) was incorporated in Delaware in 2022 and is headquartered in Cedar Park, Texas. The Company is a software as a service (“SaaS”) provider delivering a cloud-based AI agent operating system that enables enterprises, service providers, and resellers to build, deploy, and manage omnichannel AI agents that handle voice calls, text messages, emails, and web chat while automating business workflows at scale. These AI agents are used by telecom providers, managed service providers, and small and medium sized businesses across a range of industries to automate customer service, lead qualification, scheduling, sales, and other customer engagement tasks.
